verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is documented only as a per-URL conversion endpoint (r.jina.ai/<url>). The evidence shows no batch submission, async job, or crawl-queue API for processing thousands of URLs. Self-hosting, S3 caching and proxy rotation help with scale, but none of them is a batch or asynchronous scraping capability. The search endpoint fetching its top 5 results is not user-directed batch scraping.
